data.outcome_summary: This OECD factsheet summarizes PISA 2022 results for the United States for 15-year-old students in mathematics, reading, and science, using the OECD PISA 2022 Database. Students took two two-hour tests with different subject combinations across students, and completed a background questionnaire; school principals also completed a questionnaire. The factsheet reports trends since 2012 and 2018, mean performance comparisons with the OECD average and selected comparison countries, and proficiency-level distributions (e.g., shares at Level 2+ and Level 5/6). It also highlights equity-related gaps within the United States (by international ESCS quintiles and gender) and contextual indicators (belonging, discipline in mathematics lessons, safety, parental involvement, and COVID-related learning experiences). For data quality, it notes that the United States missed some PISA technical standards for school participation and student exclusion (with replacement and non-response adjustments), while the student response rate met the target; therefore, estimates should be interpreted with appropriate caution.
